metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins shared across Bogdan's projects.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development workflow skills shared across projects: the spec-driven phase/chunk workflow, writing and running automated tests (with a hook that keeps test runs targeted until a commit), business-readable Git commit messages, and the discipline for writing progress back to an issue tracker.

plugins.name: project-tooling
plugins.description: Manually-invoked project tooling: run and screenshot the app, send a demo instance's mail to a local discard sink, audit uv (Python) or npm (frontend) dependencies for updates and breaking changes, and coordinate work across Claude sessions from a to-do tracker (handover, orchestrate).

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: Project scaffolders, enabled per-project when starting something new. Provides fastapi-nuxt-scaffold: a FastAPI async backend with multiple API surfaces plus a Nuxt 4 + Vuetify 4 frontend whose API layer is generated from the backend's OpenAPI schema.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: Database schema and migration practice for FastAPI projects. Provides alembic: migration rules covering both the MySQL and PostgreSQL layouts in use.

plugins.name: help-docs
plugins.description: Installs in-app user help documentation into a Nuxt + Vuetify application: Markdown in docs/help compiled at build time, contextual help per page, a searchable topic browser, and an authoring skill written into the app itself.

plugins.name: client-comms
plugins.description: Client-facing communication about what shipped. Provides release-notes: a Romanian, business-language release email for the client's staff, built from a commit range and verified against the code, delivered as an Outlook-ready .eml with embedded screenshots. Each app supplies its facts through a small local skill.
